mapper.select: SELECT id, name, phone, email, attendance, gift_choice, mailing_address, version, created_at, updated_at FROM invitations WHERE phone = #{phone} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitations (name, phone, email, attendance, gift_choice, mailing_address, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{attendance}, #{giftChoice}, #{mailingAddress}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN n.id IS NULL OR n.task_status='CANCELLED' THEN 'NOT_SENT' WHEN n.task_status='SUCCEEDED' THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN n.task_status='FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN n.task_status='DISABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'PENDING' END
LEFT JOIN email_notifications n ON n.id=( SELECT e.id FROM email_notifications e WHERE e.invitation_id=i.id AND e.invitation_version=i.version ORDER BY e.send_no DESC LIMIT 1 )

i.id,i.name,i.phone,i.email,i.attendance,i.gift_choice,i.mailing_address, i.version,i.created_at,i.updated_at, AS email_notify_status, CASE WHEN n.task_status='SUCCEEDED' THEN n.sent_at ELSE NULL END AS email_notified_at

mapper.select: SELECT id,name,phone,email,attendance,gift_choice,mailing_address,version,created_at,updated_at FROM invitations WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM invitations i WHERE i.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invitations i WHERE 1=1
SELECT FROM invitations i WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY i.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(i.attendance='ATTENDING'),0) AS attending, COALESCE(SUM(i.attendance='NOT_ATTENDING'),0) AS not_attending, COALESCE(SUM(i.gift_choice='NONE'),0) AS none, COALESCE(SUM(i.gift_choice='PICKUP'),0) AS pickup, COALESCE(SUM(i.gift_choice='MAIL'),0) AS mail, COALESCE(SUM(()='NOT_SENT'),0) AS not_sent, COALESCE(SUM(()='PENDING'),0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(()='SUCCESS'),0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(()='FAILED'),0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(()='DISABLED'),0) AS disabled, COALESCE(SUM(i.gift_choice='MAIL' AND i.mailing_address IS NOT NULL),0) AS mailing_address_count FROM invitations i
